channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US pausing $14bn arms sale to Taiwan due to Iran war, navy chief says
item.description: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao's remarks come as US President Donald Trump gives mixed signals on the sale.

item.title: Iran war live: Signs of progress amid efforts to reach US-Iran peace deal
item.description: A new opinion poll in the US suggests that 60 percent of Americans now oppose President Donald Trump's war on Iran.

item.title: Over 2,000 gather in San Diego to mourn three men killed in mosque attack
item.description: The three men killed in the shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego were remembered as heroes at the memorial.

item.title: At least 16 people killed in two attacks in northern Honduras
item.description: One attack involved a police raid, while the other took place on a palm farm, killing rural labourers.

item.title: US sanctions elected Hezbollah MPs and Lebanese security officials
item.description: Hezbollah says the sanctions will have 'absolutely no effect' on its strategy amid ongoing Israeli attacks on Lebanon.

item.title: Trump shifts between diplomacy and threats in Iran standoff
item.description: Supporters say unpredictable Trump approach deal-making strength, others see reflection of strategic dilemma.

item.title: Iran’s World Cup hopes hit US visa hurdles
item.description: Players from Iran’s national football team are in Turkey applying for US visas for the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists deported from Israel as backlash over treatment grows
item.description: A video showing a far-right Israeli minister taunting activists who were kneeling with their hands tied behind their backs has been widely condemned.

item.title: Air France and Airbus found guilty of manslaughter over 2009 plane crash
item.description: The companies were found guilty by a French court over an air disaster which killed 228 people.
